# Optional components

What an optional feature downloads. Every file has a fixed address (a commit, a version or a release tag) and a SHA-256 that is checked before the file is used, so a changed file is refused; nothing outside this list is ever downloaded. Components live in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Folio\components` on Windows.

## Feature: Meeting recorder (`meeting-recorder`)

Records your computer’s sound and your microphone, transcribes on this computer and writes a note in Meetings/. Nothing leaves your computer.

- Platforms: win32
- Memory budget: worker 3072 MB, whole app 4096 MB
- Required: `sherpa-runtime`, `silero-vad`, `whisper-large-v3-turbo-int8`
- Notes (optional): `llama-server`, `qwen3-1.7b-q4km`
- Alternatives: asr: `parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-int8`
